title: Tech selloff weighs down Wall Street as bond yields climb
title_zh: 随着债券收益率攀升，科技股抛售拖累华尔街
summary: VIDEO SHOWS: n/aSTORY: Wall Street closed lower Tuesday with the Dow falling about a quarter of one percent, the S&P 500 slipping more than two-thirds of a percent, and the Nasdaq sliding one and a third percent. Technology stocks dropped with semiconductors suffering the...

title: Meta social media addiction trial kicks off with major implications for company's future
title_zh: 元社交媒体成瘾试验开始对公司的未来产生重大影响
summary: Meta is in court again, as it faces another social media addiction suit.
summary_zh: Meta 再次出庭，面临另一起社交媒体成瘾诉讼。

title: OpenAI releases new ChatGPT for Teens with parental controls, guardrails
title_zh: OpenAI 为青少年发布了新的 ChatGPT，具有家长控制、护栏
summary: OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) released a new version of ChatGPT with updated parental controls and safety guardrails for teenage users. Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley outlines the growing safety concerns around AI and the features of this new AI model.
summary_zh: OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) 发布了新版本的 ChatGPT，为青少年用户提供了更新的家长控制和安全护栏。雅虎财经技术编辑丹·豪利 (Dan Howley) 概述了围绕人工智能日益增长的安全问题以及这种新人工智能模型的功能。

title: Tesla's new partnership: Swedish company Einride to deploy 500 Tesla semi-truck EVs
title_zh: 特斯拉新合作伙伴：瑞典公司 Einride 将部署 500 辆特斯拉半卡车电动汽车
summary: Tesla (TSLA) is partnering with Swedish trucking company Einride (ENRD), which is deploying 500 of Tesla's electric semi-trucks. Yahoo Finance's Julie Hyman explains the details.
summary_zh: 特斯拉 (TSLA) 正在与瑞典卡车运输公司 Einride (ENRD) 合作，后者正在部署 500 辆特斯拉电动半挂卡车。雅虎财经的朱莉·海曼解释了细节。

title: What does Tesla's Cybercab launch mean for SpaceX's own ambitions?
title_zh: 特斯拉推出 Cyber​​cab 对 SpaceX 的野心意味着什么？
summary: Tesla (TSLA) showcased its new Cybercab — a version of its autonomous robotaxi without a steering wheel — ahead of its planned launch in Austin, Texas.
summary_zh: 特斯拉 (TSLA) 在计划于德克萨斯州奥斯汀推出之前展示了其新型 Cyber​​cab——一种没有方向盘的自动机器人出租车版本。
